name: San Luis de Gaceno (Colombia)
description: Green upper half, the lower half divided diagonally from the lower hoist to the upper fly, white above and red below.
history: Municipal flag of San Luis de Gaceno, a municipality in the department of Boyacá, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor.

features.role: lower half divided diagonally white over red
